neighbours.label: assertions that something has no limit or obstacle ('no limit to', 'limited only by', 'the sky is the limit', 'no reason why')
fire: With the new engine, there seems to be no limit to how fast it can go.
Kids' creativity is limited only by the materials you give them.
For a startup with this much funding, the sky's the limit.
Honestly, there is no reason why the plan should fail.
In this game there's no limit to the number of players.
Their growth is limited only by how quickly they can hire.
Once you master the basics, there's really no limit on what you can cook.
I see no reason why she can't win the title.
quiet: The new engine has a top speed of 200 kilometres an hour.
Kids may only bring two toys to the classroom.
For a startup with little funding, growth will be slow.
The plan failed because of poor weather.
In this game each team has exactly five players.
Their growth is capped at ten percent by the regulator.
The weight limit for checked bags is 23 kilograms.
She lost the title match in three sets.

notes: Probes: 'limited by your imagination' 0.58, 'no reason why' 0.49, 'sky is the limit' 0.45, 'no limit to' 0.33; 'speed limit' / 'storage limit' <0.05.
